name: Unknown-first external boundary with explicit result state
decision: External JSON/env/file/CLI/MCP inputs should enter as unknown, narrow near the boundary, and return explicit finite result states when callers need failure reasons.
falsifier: A replayable target repair can trust parsed external input directly or represent invalid input as null/boolean while the pattern gate still passes.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove real target transfer, complete TypeScript quality, automatic skill selection, or product readiness.
